☛ The order ensures logical contrast, grammatical coherence, and a smooth transition from general to specific.

Rearrangement Strategy:

☛ Look for connecting phrases (e.g., 'inaugurate' → 'new regime').
☛ Note contrast indicators (slow growth vs. suddenness).
☛ Re-read the full paragraph to check coherence.

Full Sentence: Democracy is always a slow growth, dictators may rise to power and inaugurate a new regime with dramatic suddenness and success under suitable conditions.

Full Sentence: As the world faces cascading and interlinked global crises and conflicts, the aspirations set out in the 2030 agenda for sustainable development are in jeopardy.
